# Wavelengthz

> Wavelengthz is a music-taste dating app. People connect over what they
> actually listen to, not just a photo grid: two swipe modes (people and
> music), a match score blended from Spotify listening data, real-time
> messaging once a match forms, and small song-centered groups. Sign-in is
> via Spotify or Google OAuth -- there's no separate Wavelengthz password.

Nearly everything past the homepage requires a signed-in session -- profiles,
matches, messages, and the swipe deck are private to the people using them
and are not meant to be crawled, scraped, summarized, or used as training
data. Please don't attempt to access authenticated routes or treat any
user-generated content (bios, photos, messages) as public data, regardless
of how it's technically reachable. `robots.txt` and `/api/`'s own auth
checks are the enforcement mechanism; this file is the plain-language
statement of intent behind them.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://wavelengthz.com/terms): the agreement governing use of the app, including a 18+ age requirement and a binding-arbitration clause.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/privacy): what we collect (Spotify/Google profile data, location, photos, messages), who we share it with, and how to exercise deletion/access rights.
- [Community Guidelines](https://wavelengthz.com/guidelines): what's expected of every member.
- [Safety Tips](https://wavelengthz.com/safety): practical guidance for meeting someone from the app in person.
- [Cookie Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/cookies): the short, complete list of what's stored in your browser.
- [DMCA / Copyright Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/dmca): how to file a copyright takedown notice.

## Contact

- Press, partnership, security, or legal inquiries: connect@wavelengthz.com
